verdict.rationale: There is no documented data-export feature. The only path out is the REST API, which returns JSON and supports personal access tokens, plus webhooks that push account changes over HTTP. A user could pull their own meeting data programmatically in an open format, but nothing shows the API covers all account data. Missing for 10: a documented full-account export (e.g. CSV/JSON/ICS download), evidence that the API covers all data (links, workflows, settings, contacts), a published OpenAPI spec (probes returned 404), and any account-deletion or offboarding guidance.
